# Lucoze

> Lucoze is healthcare management software (HMS/EMR) for Indian clinics and hospitals. Patient records, appointments, billing, lab, and pharmacy on one platform, with all patient data hosted in India. Built by Svasamm Research Pvt. Ltd.

Lucoze is an India-first clinic and hospital management system (HMS/EMR). It is designed around Indian workflows and compliance: ABDM/ABHA integration, DPDP 2023, GST-compliant e-invoicing, and Hindi UI. Founder-led by Mithun K. Singh. Data residency is in Indian data centres; customers can export all records (CSV/PDF) with no lock-in.

Lucoze is the product; Svasamm Research Pvt. Ltd. is the company that builds it. Lucoze is business software sold to healthcare providers — it is not a consumer product, a medical device, or a healthcare provider itself.

## Product
- [Appointments](https://lucoze.com/in/features/appointments/): Department-first booking, family-linked patient timelines, reminders.
- [Patient records](https://lucoze.com/in/features/patient-records/): Unified EMR, ABHA-linked records, multilingual patient search.
- [Billing, accounting & inventory](https://lucoze.com/in/features/billing/): GST-compliant invoicing (CGST/SGST/IGST), e-invoicing, shared pharmacy/OPD ledger.
- [Lab](https://lucoze.com/in/features/lab/): Sample-to-report tracking, reference-range flagging, NABL-oriented audit trail.
- [Pharmacy](https://lucoze.com/in/features/pharmacy/): Inventory, batch/expiry, FEFO dispensing, Schedule-H/X handling.
- [HR](https://lucoze.com/in/features/hr/): Attendance, statutory PF/ESI/TDS payroll, department incentives.

## Solutions
- [For clinics](https://lucoze.com/in/solutions/clinics/)
- [For hospitals](https://lucoze.com/in/solutions/hospitals/)
- [Pricing](https://lucoze.com/in/pricing/): Plans from ₹1,499/month, 14-day free trial.

## By type of practice
- [Dental groups](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/dental/): Chair-led practices — scheduling keyed to the chair rather than the doctor.
- [Dermatology](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/dermatology/): Dermatology and cosmetic practices.
- [Diagnostic centres](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/diagnostics/): Sample-to-report workflow.
- [IVF clinics](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/ivf/): Cycle-based workflow.
- [Multi-specialty clinics](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/multispecialty/): 3–15 doctors.
- [Nursing homes](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/nursing-home/): 10–50 beds.
- [Polyclinics](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/polyclinic/): High-volume OPD.
- [Small hospitals](https://lucoze.com/in/specialties/small-hospital/): 20–100 beds.
